I wrote my Master's thesis on the topic of Particle Markov Chain Monte Carlo 
(PMCMC) methods, which are used for Bayesian inference in state space models. 

<!--more--> 

[Click here to view the thesis](Thesis.pdf)

Alongside the thesis, I also developed an R package called `bayesSSM`,
which implements PMCMC methods for state space models. The package is available 
on CRAN and can be installed using the following command:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages("bayesSSM")
```

View it on GitHub [here](https://github.com/BjarkeHautop/bayesSSM).
